## Summary

Describe the focused change and its motivation.

## Evidence level

- [ ] Implementation only
- [ ] Synthetic software verification
- [ ] Public empirical evidence (identify source and license)
- [ ] Documentation only

## Checks

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `mypy`
- [ ] No restricted data, credentials, private paths, real item-level outputs, or prohibited files
- [ ] Claims remain within `docs/evidence_boundaries.md`
